concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-reconciliation-use-cases-first-year-focus-platform-user-level-reporting]] — 2026-09-15 Platforms SMB-user transaction, payout, and dispute reporting options, separating UI components from accounting/payout-report grains and financial from non-financial events.
warnings: Tables are illustrative; a transaction row's net-payout figure is not derivable from that row alone and must not be used as a formula.
Balance Platform Accounting Report covers financial chargeback entries, not non-financial dispute events or workflow status.
A payout report row/date or component view does not prove bank receipt; user/account/date/reference scoping is needed.
